facts.fact: Vedra 撑起身，看见那头巨犬的尸体躺在近旁，胸口插着一支箭。
facts.anchor: The corpse of the great hound lay nearby

facts.fact: 尸体白得像磨过的羊皮纸，伤口流出的血是夜一样的黑。
Ivar 说等 Tynon 的侦察队回来，营中将有近六十人。
facts.anchor: we will be close to three score here

facts.fact: Mearna 自嘲「六十人对两支大军」，话一出口自己先觉得苦。
facts.anchor: Her own jibe sour in her mouth

facts.fact: Tynon 用树枝在泥地上划出一道竖线，代表 Baraillean 河。
facts.anchor: This line stands for the River Baraillean

facts.fact: Tynon 指望 Hagan 北上，好挑动两个私生兄弟的兵互斗。
facts.anchor: provoke a fight between the troops of the two bastard brothers

facts.fact: Vedra 当面问 Xaniko，自己究竟做错了什么。
facts.anchor: I asked what I have done to displease you

facts.fact: Flann 说既然已经在打仗，若失败这片土地就要血流成河。
facts.anchor: this land will be awash in blood
